full_page.content:
1949, October 29
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
St. Felix Friary Huntington, Indiana Capuchin Franciscan Fathers 1949, October 29th
Miss Beatrice McCahill Chicago, Illinois
Dear Miss McCahill:
God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your favor of September 30. Your "write-up" in the best weekly news-paper, THE NEW WORLD, was very good. Father Elmer, the Master of Novices, smilingly called my attention to it. I do hope you get time from your busy duties of nursing, to be as successful with your "write", about the, comparatively little known though prolific Seraphic Mass Association.
In regard to the benefits and blessings reported as through this quiet little organization, I have longsince been convinced and have frequently exclaimed -
(unfinished draft)
